A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''commander''' in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and had a [[Unidentified Imperial commander's son|son]] who was arrested on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] for an embarrassing indiscretion. As a result, the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] hired outside help to bribe the jailers and secure his son's release.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Youthful Indiscretions}}</ref>
